methods: Read complete launcher and prior-NLL source, fixed decoder/scorer contracts and pinned process runner.
Reran author lifecycle and negative CPU tests, plus seven independently written guard tests with 24 subtests.
Independent tests exercise real payload receipt schema validator, tiny local files, same-length post-verification mutation, symlink rejection, environment drift, generation report bindings.
Rehashed both final implementation receipts and all their bound inputs.

findings.issue: Relative or symlink-alias adapter paths could be accepted during preparation then rejected by later output checks.
findings.resolution: Author added canonical absolute path checks before helper imports and duplicate adapter-directory rejection; current source/tests pass.

confirmed_boundaries: Fixed eight task messages, prompt IDs, source evidence and greedy eight-token cap are hash bound; model, runtime, installed packages, Python executable, adapter configs/weights/state, arithmetic mode and TF32-off environment are guarded.
Generation uses serial observed child PIDs, bound argv/cwd/environment and output/log hashes; child failure is preserved and no retry/resume or checkpoint selection is automatic.

The prior-NLL path separately requires a completed five-phase training launch, exact final checkpoint selected by the frozen training helper, the same 16 prepared test rows/masks, and observed independent evaluation PID.
Prefix and decoded caches are disabled for these comparisons.
Payload receipts require previous full-byte source/destination equality; subsequent local inventory/stat guards reject changed files without rereading the full checkpoint for every question.
required_before_actual_execution: Independently review the concrete generation request and sealed plan against the completed M5 training launch and its fixed 396-step final checkpoint. Generic generation launcher configuration alone does not bind that training-selection decision.
Require actual completed full-payload transfer verification, both adapters, correct execution-host paths and reviewed source/runtime/package hashes before sealing.
Independently audit actual child receipts and scores afterward; these CPU tests are not evidence that M5 inference or training has completed.
limitations: Trusted local quiescent-filesystem integrity, not hostile-host/process attestation or proof against forged consistent local receipts.
Mocked lifecycle tests plus real small CPU guard fixtures; no real subprocess inference/model computation was executed in this review.
Diagnostic score concerns fixed short choices and prior held-out teacher-forced NLL; no generated-kernel compilation, correctness, speed or generalization result is implied.
No new model-quality result or unique causal mechanism is established.
